contributions.detail: Schedule A (p2) carries NO transaction. The only ink in the grid area is a bare '$0' typed at the far left of the first row slot (PDF-text bbox x=40.18pt, i.e. inside the Date column, x=6.57% of page width) with no date, no contributor name and no address — it is the filer's nil notation for the schedule, not an itemized line, so zero rows are emitted (core brief section 6: 'do not transcribe what is not a field'). Printed 'Subtotal for this page $ $0' and 'Total Contributions Received $ $0' both close at 0.00 with zero rows. Box B (this period) $0 and Box C (year-to-date) $0 are EQUAL, so the two scopes coincide degenerately at zero; recorded as cumulative per the cache addendum section C. This CFD form has no separate '$50.00 or less' aggregate line at all, so the le50 keys are null, not 0.

expenditures.detail: One expenditure row summing 187.95. It equals the printed 'Subtotal for this page $ $187.95', the printed 'Total Expenditures Made $ $187.95' AND Summary-Page Box D 'Expenditures Made This Period' $187.95. It does NOT equal Box E 'Expenditures Made Year-to-Date' $687.95, so the rows are on the PERIOD scope, not the cycle-to-date scope. This is the scope the chunk file hypothesised (period_basis=cfd_period_ytd, scope_status=period_and_ytd_differ) and the page confirms it. The $500.00 difference between Box E and Box D is prior-period spending itemised in this filer's EARLIER report of the cycle; nothing in this document itemises it and no figure was synthesised by differencing.

Cross-filing chain check (this filing's TOTALS-FROM-LAST-REPORT vs an earlier filing's cumulative column) is NOT RUNNABLE here: the CFD form has no 'totals from last report' column at all, and this chunk contains only this one document by this filer.

LAYOUT NOTE for downstream: on both schedules this filer's field values render STACKED in the left margin (each field on its own line at x=37.36pt) rather than spread across the Date/Vendor/Purpose/Amount columns — a form-field rendering artifact of the flattened PDF, not a field shift. Field-shift screen passes on its content test: line 1 is date-shaped, line 2 name-shaped, line 3 purpose-shaped, line 4 amount-shaped, in exactly the form's printed column order, and the count of names (1) equals the count of amounts (1). Columns are therefore assigned by ORDER, confidently, and the amount assignment is independently confirmed by the printed subtotal.
